social.title: Real stories.
social.body: Interviews conducted by the Gastify team with young people in Lima (September 2026). 100% had at least one forgotten automatic charge. 100% have dollar subscriptions without knowing their cost in soles.

testimonials.quote: I kept PedidosYa active for a promo that had already expired. They charged me 2 months in a row and I found out by chance while checking the bank. A 24h alert would have stopped it before the first charge.

Smart Fit charged me for 2 months without going to the gym, zero notification. I pay ChatGPT and Amazon in dollars and never knew how much that was in soles until my card limit dropped. That has to be fixed.
LinkedIn Premium charged me ~$40 three months in a row after I got the job and forgot to cancel it. I only saw it in my statement. An alert 24h earlier would have saved me the trouble.
